notes.title: THANK YOU!
notes.content:
[h2]WHAT AN INCREDIBLE ALPHA WEEKEND 💥 [/h2][p]I’m truly blown away by the turnout and support. Seeing so many of you jump in, play, and sharing all these positive feedback is incredibly rewarding to witness. 🙌  [/p][p]Your enthusiasm for [b]OKUBI[/b] is heartwarming and I couldn’t be more thrilled.[/p][p]Thank you for being part of this.[/p][p][/p][h3]🔥 HIGHLIGHT WEEKEND STATS[/h3][p]Here's some crazy stats I captured during the event!
 [/p][p][b]249 Unique Players 🤯[/b][/p][p][b]1,176 Arena Deployments ⚔️[/b][/p][p][b]2,358 Player Kills ☠️[/b][/p][p][b]9,762 Dummies Destroyed 🎯[/b] 
[/p][p]You guys went wild — I love it.
[/p][h3]⚠️ IMPORTANT NOTICE[/h3][p]👉 There was some rare case where players experienced 3x stats during Matches due to an unexpected issue. This caused [b]insane [/b]burst damage and one-shots in certain cases and I want to emphasize that this wasn't intended. I'm currently working on a fix and I thank you for your understanding.[/p][p][/p][h3]🎮 TO AVOID ANY CONFUSION[/h3][p]⚔️ [b]Arenas are 100% skill-based [/b]⚔️
[/p][p]My priority with [b]OKUBI[/b] is fairness and competiteveness. I will always work toward an healthy balance and ''Time To Kill''. Player stats are NOT affected by gear or levels in Arenas — only your skill and knowledge matters.

[b]OKUBI[/b] is meant to be high-skill-cap with absolutely NO pay-to-win and NO stat monsters ruining matches. 

🤝 Whether you're new or experienced, everyone fights on equal ground and has a chance to win.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]
Thanks again for this weekend and stay tuned...[/p][p]🚨 BIG NEWS COMING NEXT WEEK   👀[/p][p]
- Skeltonjohn[/p]

notes.title: Major Server Expansion Goes Live!
notes.content:
[h2]Great news, Remnants!!![/h2]

[h3]Okubi's server network just got a massive upgrade! [/h3]
Now boasting over 615 locations worldwide to boost connectivity and slash game lag. 

My priority is to ensure a responsive gaming experience wherever you are so this global expansion massively enhances network stability.

[b]Check out the new server map to see the current locations.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42856418/6f0d4a286dbd497eaba799638946cadcbe74283b.png[/img]
[i]Note: Currently, all regions are linked for playtest purposes, but they will soon be separated to optimize your connections and gameplay experience in the future.[/i]

[h1]Revamped Matchmaking System[/h1]
I've completely reworked the matchmaking system, allowing you to easily queue for different battlegrounds and arena modes through a newly designed match mode selector. Choose your preferred combat settings with ease, ready up, and return to your activities in the hub. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42856418/d8d8a5bde5bf2854e19a1f9f243042ab43bea05d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42856418/4cad6554be4a2b9f0317fa25072ebd2cf1e76eef.png[/img]
Actually not diamond... I'm bad at the game. @incap is better.

[h1]Match Acceptance with Active Status Tracking[/h1]
With the updated system, you can now accept matches as soon as they're ready, keeping you in the action without being unexpectedly kidnapped. I've also added an icon in the top right corner to track your matchmaking status, allowing you to continue enjoying activities in the public hub without the need to open the matchmaker.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42856418/1f0c1cbb51798294dc422a646908b2dfefcbb34f.png[/img]

[h1]Addition of a Brand New Rewards System![/h1]
After each match, reap the rewards of your conquests! I've just implemented a new rewards system that recognizes your participation and achievements, providing exciting incentives and prizes at the conclusion of each game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42856418/a38767cc91a26ff1c5d05f5b506e19135566b5bb.png[/img]

[h1]Engaged Community[/h1]
Our Discord is home to the most active and engaged community members. Join us there to chat with other players and stay tuned to the latest news.
[url=https://discord.gg/jYMxgu7Ruc][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42856418/c24916c5e1e716cb258e825cb75185fc37296d30.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Oh.... I almost forgot...[/h1]

[b]Make sure you request your access to the next playtest:[/b]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2118100/OKUBI/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42856418/57e6bb246f1e6b5dbe79ea33a211fd814c98aa05.png[/img][/url]

I'm thrilled to roll out these updates and can't wait for you to dive in and experience them firsthand. 

Your continued support fuels my will to continuously improve the game. As a solo developer, seeing this much interest in Okubi really lights up my days.

[h1]Thank you.[/h1]

Best regards, 
[b]Skeltonjohn[/b]

notes.title: Okubi's Development Update
notes.content:
[h2][b]UI Update: Achievements and Favor System[/b][/h2]

In a recent development update for Okubi, we are thrilled to unveil exciting changes to the user interface, focusing on the introduction of the Achievement Prompt, the new favor gain system tied to accomplishments during gameplay and introducing several impactful features that promise to enhance gameplay immersion and tactical awareness.

[h2][i]Achievement Prompt[/i][/h2]

One of the highlights in this update is the introduction of the Achievement Prompt. Players will now receive real-time notifications and visual cues when they unlock achievements during their gameplay sessions. Whether it's a remarkable kill streak, mastering a challenging skill, or completing specific in-game objectives, the Achievement Prompt enhances the sense of accomplishment and provides immediate acknowledgment for players' successes.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/42856418/4d407567c9d90b90ea4015df6271d8360b64c3b1.gif[/img]

[h2][i]Favor Gain Upon Achievement Completion[/i][/h2]

Taking the gaming experience a step further, Okubi now rewards players with favors upon completing achievements. Favors serve as a valuable in-game currency, allowing players to unlock unique items, skins, or abilities. This addition not only enriches the overall gaming experience but also provides players with a tangible incentive to explore various aspects of the game and master its mechanics.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/42856418/497e188a2657eaede6dba0773006e32f4378837b.gif[/img]

[h2][i]Compass system and Minimap[/i][/h2]

Embarking on epic battles is now more strategic than ever with the addition of a detailed minimap and a sophisticated compass system. The minimap provides a comprehensive overview of the game environment, displaying key landmarks, objectives, and the positions of both allies and adversaries. Complementing this, the compass system offers real-time directional information, ensuring players can navigate the game world with precision and make informed strategic decisions.

[h2][i]New Player Healthbar/Energy Bar UI[/i][/h2]

A revamped Player Healthbar and Energy Bar UI adds a layer of sophistication to the visual experience. The healthbar, now more intuitive and dynamic, provides a clear representation of a player's vitality during intense engagements. The energy bar, strategically positioned, showcases the availability of special abilities or maneuvers, empowering players to gauge their tactical options at a glance.

[h2][i]Ultimate Readiness Indicator[/i][/h2]

Your most powerful tool is now measurable with the introduction of the Ultimate Readiness Indicator. This feature displays the availability of a player's ultimate ability, once enough energy have been stacked up. This offers a strategic advantage in timing its deployment during critical moments.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/42856418/dfb2db0f5704bfc3089712d210f0243c32c80574.png[/img]

Thank you for your unwavering support. Okubi is committed to constant evolution, dedicated to delivering an engaging multiplayer experience. It's important to note that all our resources are actively invested in the game itself, driving hundreds of changes and improvements that may not always be explicitly discussed. We appreciate your patience toward these news broadcasts. Stay tuned for more updates, and thank you for your understanding.

notes.title: Pathfinder, the Dragon's Eye Warden
notes.content:
[h2][b]Unleashing the ranged terror unto the Battlefield![/b][/h2]

Hey ya'll,

We've got some exciting news in our latest game update - the Pathfinder class! This new addition is all about dynamic and versatile gameplay, seamlessly mixing ground and aerial combat. The Pathfinder is here to shake things up on the battlefield, giving even the notorious Reaper a run for its money! ;) 

[h2][i]Swift Ground Attacks and Dashes[/i][/h2]

Picture this: with the Pathfinder, you can swiftly navigate the battlefield, pulling off lightning-fast ground attacks and dashes. Mastering the art of mobility to outmaneuver your opponents, dominating with precision and finesse.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/42856418/15183400e8f1066f1d330ed3d13de5c725b95651.gif[/img]

[h2][i]Upgraded Mid-Air Basic Attack[/i][/h2]

Take combat to new heights with the Pathfinder's upgraded mid-air basic attack. Whether soaring through the skies or striking from above, your Pathfinder will be a force to be reckoned with. 

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/42856418/381b7f06b552fa98049ee7e10d4557503ace8420.gif[/img]

[h2][i]Explosive Shot for AoE Mayhem[/i][/h2]

Ready to cause chaos? The Pathfinder's Explosive Shot deals devastating AOE damage, making it a powerhouse in teamfights against clumped enemies. Unleash this spell and watch your enemies scatter!

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/42856418/9d0691bfb8687c87734ff5032a5ac1e3f20ff775.gif[/img]

[h2][i]Setting Trap on the battlefield[/i][/h2]

Get tactical! The Pathfinder can set traps anywhere on the battlefield, even on vertical walls. Enemies crossing the trap trigger an explosion, causing AOE damage and slowing everyone nearby.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/42856418/7fb26d40423b0bca304a824bc13ad47b92a7e341.gif[/img]

Stay tuned for more details, as the Pathfinder have many more abilities to discover. Get ready to try its full potential in the next playtest! Your adventure begins here - don't miss out! 🌟
I'll also be dropping an other newsletter tomorrow morning with more updates on OKUBI !! 
Hope you'll take a look as well :)

Safe travels,
Skeltonjohn

notes.title: Upcoming Monthly Playtests and Discord Launch!
notes.content:
Hello everyone and welcome !

First and foremost, I want to express my sincere gratitude to everyone who participated in previous tests. All these positive feedbacks and valuable insights have giving me an enormous amount of motivation to keep growing and pushing Okubi to it's full potential.

As a solo dev, needless to say that I've poured my heart and soul into this project. 
Seeing how the community is growing deeply warms my heart.


[h2]Monthly Playtests[/h2]

I am very happy with the current state of Okubi and believe it's time to involve more players into the process. 

Over the next three months, I will be organizing monthly playtests to give players a feel for the game and gather community feedback. Testers will have the opportunity to explore the first public hub, experience upcoming in-game features, and participate in various arena game modes such as 1v1, 2v2, 3v3, and WANTED.

Register at https://www.okubi.gg/registerforplaytests to secure your spot for one of the available dates or leave your email for future opportunities.


[h2]Discord channel Launch[/h2]

To facilitate direct communication, I will be launching the official Okubi Discord server prior to the next playtest on July 28th. Stay tuned for channel information and the official launch date.

Don't forget to register for the playtests and keep an eye out for further updates.

Thank you all for your support and enthusiasm. I can't wait to see you in-game and hear your thoughts!

- Skeltonjohn

notes.title: Okubi's Progress Update
notes.content:
[h2][b]A Look into Okubi's Development: [/b][/h2]

In an update on Okubi's current status, I am excited to share a major achievement: 

[i]The successful completion of the matchmaking system. [/i]

This milestone marks a significant advancement as players can now seamlessly transition from the vibrant Hub to various game modes, engaging in various battles with other players.

With the integration of the matchmaking system within the hub, players can easily access different game modes, ranging from intense PvP arenas to thrilling team-based challenges. The enhanced functionality ensures a fluid and uninterrupted gameplay experience, allowing for quick and seamless transitions between the hub and exciting battles.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/42856418/8926d0eb59f815e6ff6c22b2213c2b3d2de711f5.png[/img]

[h2]Updates and improved user experience[/h2]

Following multiple tests, I was provided valuable insights that allowed necessary gameplay adjustments. These updates aim to enhance the overall user experience, ensuring a more immersive adventure for players.

Looking ahead, I am preparing for an upcoming stress test. This trial will evaluate server performance as players explore the hub, participate in different arenas, and experience seamless gameplay across modes. Data gathered from this stress test will help optimize server functionality for a smoother experience at launch.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/42856418/46372dd666959646d6d7752c18e3365d4cf3fa96.png[/img]

[h2]Upcoming gameplay video and stress test[/h2]

To showcase the latest additions, Okubi will be releasing a highly anticipated video. This video offers a glimpse into intense PvP combat, highlighting new features and improvements. Players can expect strategic battles, diverse character abilities, and an immersive world designed to engage their senses.

Thank you everyone for your support, Okubi will continue to evolve, with each update and test solidifying its foundation as a captivating multiplayer experience.

Stay tuned for more updates as Okubi progresses towards launch.
